rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACmantha
Exhibition name: Samantha ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, 1974).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) as 'Samantha'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Flowers current red. Mild fragrance. 30 to 40 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, classic hybrid tea, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, leathery foliage.

Height: up to 4¼' (up to 130cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
